method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks slump, bonds leap as AI giants' spending spooks investors
Equities.reason: Broad market narrative: earnings-driven risk-off tied to large AI-capex plans is driving equity weakness and cross-asset flows into bonds. This is a market-level, macro-risk story that dominates the equities theme today.

Equities.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, holds 2026 capex unchanged
Equities.summary: Amazon's negative free cash flow ballooned during the third quarter, while its earnings and revenue fell short of Wall Street's expectations.
Equities.reason: Large-cap leadership signal: Amazon's massive negative FCF and earnings miss weakens the growth/AI leadership narrative and raises market risk appetite concerns.

Equities.title: Intel stock plunges 21% as chipmaker blames PC slowdown for weak guidance
Equities.summary: Intel has been a Wall Street darling this year due to its emergence as a player in AI, but the company is being weighed down by a struggling PC market.
Equities.reason: Leader-specific shock with systemic effects: a big miss and guidance cut at a major AI-related chip supplier reinforces sector-wide re-pricing and risk-off in tech-heavy indices.

Equities.title: Alphabet tanks nearly 13% for worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value
Equities.summary: Alphabet reported a larger negative free cash flow than analysts had expected while maintaining its spending gudiance for the year.
Equities.reason: Major cap-weight leader shock: Alphabet's heavy market-cap loss and continued spending guidance amplify AI-capex jitters and elevate downside risk for broad indices.

Equities.title: ServiceNow shares plunge 27% to worst day ever after earnings revive AI disruption fears
Equities.summary: ServiceNow's stock recorded its worst day ever on underwhelming third-quarter results.
Equities.reason: Earnings-led sentiment hit for a high-multiple software name, reinforcing the theme that AI-related spending and execution concerns are prompting re-rating across software/AI beneficiaries.

Equities.title: Nasdaq-100 futures fall as Amazon and Intel swoon after earnings
Equities.reason: Market microstructure indicator: futures weakness in the Nasdaq-100 reflects immediate risk-off spillover from earnings shocks at key market leaders.

Equities.title: Tech Stock Selloff Deepens on Earnings, Bonds Rise: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Consolidated market narrative: Bloomberg wrap highlights the broad, cross-market nature of the tech-led selloff and rising bond demand, signaling regime shift toward risk-off.

Equities.title: Japan's Nikkei slumps 3% as tech stocks tumble on AI worries
Equities.reason: Regional equity transmission: significant Asian tech weakness (Nikkei) underlines the global nature of the AI-capex re-rating and contributes to downward pressure on global risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Chinese Investors Seek Shelter in Long-Bond ETFs as Stocks Sink
Equities.reason: Flow signal away from equities: move into long-duration bond ETFs in China signals risk-off positioning and equity-to-bond reallocations, reinforcing the broader negative equities narrative.

Rates.title: BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
Rates.summary: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.
Rates.reason: BOJ saying underlying inflation has hit 2% is a structural signal toward policy normalization; reduces justification for prolonged accommodation and raises JGB/yield downside risk (i.e. pressure for higher yields). High relevance given BoJ's market impact.

Rates.title: Ueda Speech: BoJ Governor discusses policy outlook after the expected interest rate hold
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda is addressing the press conference, explaining the reason behind leaving the key interest rate unchanged at 1.25% in the October policy meeting.
Rates.reason: Governor Ueda's post-meeting remarks reinforce the BoJ's policy shift narrative (hold but validating higher inflation) — modestly bearish for bonds/yields as markets price reduced accommodation; medium-low relevance vs. formal decisions.

Rates.title: (Reference) Outlook Report and Indicators Related to Underlying Inflation
Rates.reason: BOJ published technical outlook/underlying-inflation indicators supporting the view inflation has normalized; incremental confirmation of policy normalization pressure on yields, but mostly technical (lower relevance).

Rates.title: (Reference) Decisions regarding a Change in the Pace of Sales of ETFs (October 2026)
Rates.reason: BOJ operational changes to ETF sales/reductions in asset support reduce central-bank market support; modest negative for risk asset liquidity and bond market breadth, but narrower direct rates impact.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statement is a primary driver of US rate expectations; given recent data (strong growth and sticky inflation) the statement supports a higher-for-longer pricing bias — negative for bond prices/higher yields with high relevance.

Rates.title: Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates
Rates.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to increase 0.5% in September for an annual rate of 3.7%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
Rates.reason: Stronger-than-expected GDP alongside accelerating inflation increases odds of persistent Fed tightening or delayed cuts — upward pressure on US yields (negative for bonds) with material relevance to the rates complex.

Rates.title: Treasuries Extend Rally With Global Peers as Risk-Off Haven
Rates.reason: Headline indicates a material Treasury rally as investors seek havens amid equity stress — yields lower (positive for bond prices). High relevance given direct market-moving move in Treasuries.

Rates.title: Rupee to benefit from dollar retreat, plunging US yields; oil surge tempers impact
Rates.reason: Article explicitly links plunging US yields to FX flows; confirms a meaningful move lower in US yields which supports bond-market rally dynamics — moderate relevance to rates via cross-market transmission.

Rates.title: Equities and bond yields dip with AI jitters and economic data in focus
Rates.reason: Market-piece noting both equities and bond yields falling (yields down) — signals risk-off demand for duration and near-term lower yields; useful corroboration of Treasury rally, moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Warsh’s ‘Forward Silence’ Risks Bigger Treasury Market Swings
Rates.reason: Discussion of Fed officials' reduced communication raising the potential for larger Treasury volatility — small negative tilt as higher uncertainty can amplify rate moves; modest relevance.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: One last central bank surprise
Rates.reason: Macro commentary flagging potential final central-bank surprises — small negative for bond markets if surprises are hawkish; limited direct actionable info so low relevance.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Holds gains to near 1.1200, while staying below key technical resistance
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1190 during the early European trading hours on Friday. A hawkish pause from the European Central Bank (ECB) provides some support to the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: ECB hawkish pause is providing support to the euro and aligns with broader USD softness — constructive for EURUSD. Moderate relevance as a direct USD-pair move.

FX.title: British Pound gains due to hawkish BoE outlook, subdued US Dollar
FX.summary: GBP/USD extends its gains for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.3400 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the British Pound (GBP) gains ground on hawkish sentiment surrounding the Bank of England’s (BoE) upcoming policy decision next
FX.reason: GBP bid driven by hawkish BoE expectations and a softer USD — supportive for GBPUSD. Good FX-native signal but single-pair focus limits relevance slightly.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ signals inflation milestone before December decision – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister reports that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) left rates unchanged after September’s hike, but delivered a hawkish signal by indicating underlying price pressures have reached the 2% target. A further rate increase in December is seen as i
FX.reason: BoJ signalling that inflation has hit the 2% threshold and a potential December hike is an important regime shift for JPY — implies sustained JPY strength (lower USD/JPY). High relevance for global FX flows.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index slips as US-Iran hopes cap safe-haven bid
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the third successive day and trading near 101.70 during Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: DXY decline on easing US-Iran safe-haven demand is a broad USD-weakness signal that lifts major dollar crosses (EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY). High relevance for cross-asset FX flows.

FX.title: Euro extends post-ECB recovery from YTD low and retakes 1.1200 vs weak USD
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair builds on the previous day's goodish rebound from the 1.1100 neighborhood, or a fresh low since May 2025, gaining positive traction for the third straight day on Friday.
FX.reason: EUR reclaiming 1.1200 from YTD lows reinforces the ECB/ EUR recovery narrative amid a softer USD — supports euro crosses. Moderate-high relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar stands firm near September 16 top vs weak USD amid bullish oil prices
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair attracts sellers for the third straight day, sliding to a fresh low since September 16 during the Asian session on Friday amid a broadly weaker US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: USD/CAD selling pressure as CAD holds near a recent top — reflects commodity/link to oil and broader USD weakness. Direct USD-pair signal with moderate relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar Poised for Best Month Since April After BOC Hike
FX.reason: Bloomberg highlights a BoC-driven CAD rally — central-bank hikes are high-impact drivers for USD/CAD and broader USD crosses. High relevance and material for FX positioning.

FX.title: Yen Extends Gains Against Dollar After BOJ Keeps Rates Steady
FX.reason: Bloomberg confirms JPY strength after BoJ decision — reinforces the yen-run narrative and is market-moving for USD/JPY and cross flows. High relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee continues to face pressure from Middle East risks
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) remains under pressure against the US Dollar (USD), as oil prices continue to boil due to Middle East risks. In the opening trade on Friday, the USD/INR pair is slightly higher to near 95.25, closer to its over two-week high of 95.38 pos
FX.reason: USD/INR drifting higher on oil and geopolitical risk — negative for INR and highlights EM vulnerability. Lower relevance than G10 moves but still FX-native.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah faces foreign outflow pressures amid weaker market sentiment
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground after three days of losses, trading around 18,180 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair continues to appreciate as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces downward pressure from potential foreign capital outflows.
FX.reason: USD/IDR rising on foreign outflow risk — signals EM FX pressure and potential USD safe-haven repricing in local markets. Lower-medium relevance for global FX.

Commodities.title: Gold slips as higher oil, US inflation data bolster Fed hike bets
Commodities.reason: Hawkish US inflation/Fed-hike expectations are a direct headwind for gold (higher real rates), while higher oil may add inflationary pressure; strong macro driver so high relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold approaches monthly low, seems vulnerable below $4,000 amid Fed rate hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) remains under heavy selling pressure for the second straight day, trading below the $4,000 psychological mark heading into Friday’s European session amid hawkish US Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations.
Commodities.reason: Price/technical-focused note showing continued selling pressure on gold tied to Fed-rate expectations; relevant but more price-technical in nature so slightly lower relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slumps to fresh low since November, near $51.00
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its descending trend for the third straight day, hitting a fresh low since November 2025 during the Asian session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Silver is plunging alongside gold and faces pressure from both rate-driven gold weakness and weaker industrial demand; price move is material for the metal complex.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Pulls back from multi-month top near 104.00 as bullish bias holds
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – retreats after touching a fresh high since May 19, around the $104.00 mark during the Asian session on Friday, though the downside seems limited.
Commodities.reason: Technical/forecast piece indicating limited downside and persistent bullish bias for WTI; positive for oil but price-technical stories carry capped relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Climbs on Signs US May Resume Military Strikes Against Iran
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation (possible US strikes on Iran) raises near-term oil risk premium and is a major driver for crude prices and market sentiment—high directionality and relevance.

Commodities.title: China’s Oil Majors Get More Firepower for Energy Security Push
Commodities.reason: Policy/strategic support for Chinese oil firms implies stronger long-run demand/stockbuilding and higher marginal demand for crude; material for oil fundamentals and market tone.

Commodities.title: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
Commodities.summary: Iran said four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, while Tehran disputed a U.S. claim that key shipping lanes had been cleared.
Commodities.reason: Reported incidents in the Strait of Hormuz raise transportation risk and oil risk premia; clear near-term bullish impulse for crude markets and refined products.

Commodities.title: Rio Tinto’s Oyu Tolgoi Copper Mine Halts Underground Operations
Commodities.reason: Suspension of underground operations at a major copper asset is a supply disruption with direct price implications for copper; meaningful supply-side shock so above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Potential Gulf Coast production shut-ins from a hurricane create short-term supply risk for oil and natural gas production; clear bullish impulse for energy prices and risk premia.

Commodities.title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
Commodities.summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. A potential drought this fall and winter could limit the availability of hydroelectric generation and boost the country's demand for natural gas power generation.
Commodities.reason: Rising LNG imports to cover falling domestic production (and drought-driven power demand) increase near-term demand for natural gas/LNG flows—supportive for gas prices in the region.

Crypto.title: Biggest-ever crypto hack impacts $6.3 billion as Binance works to contain fallout
Crypto.summary: Binance estimated the impact of a security incident at $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in crypto assets frozen, and pledged to cover all losses.
Crypto.reason: Large-scale security breach at the sector's largest exchange implies major counterparty, liquidity and custody risk — highly negative for crypto prices and flows; the article quantifies the hit and frozen assets, increasing market impact.

Crypto.title: Binance halts withdrawals after record $6.3bn heist
Crypto.summary: World’s largest crypto exchange says an engineer’s laptop was compromised in one of sector’s biggest security breaches
Crypto.reason: Withdrawal freezes at a major exchange amplify counterparty/liquidity fears and likely trigger outflows, deleveraging and price pressure; the FT detail on compromised internal security raises credibility concerns.

Crypto.title: Binance loses over $6 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
Crypto.reason: CoinDesk reporting of a multi-billion loss at the largest exchange is highly market-negative: it signals systemic counterparty risk, probable asset freezes and confidence shock across spot and derivatives markets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
Crypto.reason: Large liquidations indicate forced deleveraging and amplified volatility; this reinforces a negative short-term price dynamic following the exchange security shock.

Crypto.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
Crypto.reason: Institutional withdrawals materially damage exchange liquidity and custody economics; a flight of institutional capital is a meaningful negative for market depth and medium-term flows.

Crypto.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
Crypto.reason: Irrecoverable dispersion of stolen bitcoin raises permanence of losses and undermines claims of full restitution; increases counterparty risk and reduces confidence in exchange-rescue narratives.

Crypto.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
Crypto.reason: Attribution to a state-linked hacking group elevates geopolitical and regulatory risk, increases likelihood of sanctions/AML scrutiny and heightens long-term reputational damage to exchanges.

Crypto.title: Where Binance's $6.3 billion breach ranks in crypto's biggest hacks and heists
Crypto.reason: Contextual ranking underscores systemic scale of the breach; useful market context but lower marginal new information versus primary breach reports.

Crypto.title: Crypto giant Binance freezes $2.5bn of assets over suspected hack
Crypto.reason: Reported asset freezes at a top exchange are a direct hit to customer access and market functioning, increasing short-term selling pressure and counterparty fear.

Crypto.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
Crypto.reason: Reserve-drain evidence implies that customer assets were materially impacted rather than isolated hot-wallet losses, aggravating solvency and trust concerns for exchanges broadly.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
Crypto.reason: Macro headlines (Fed dissent) and sector-specific flows (AI token weakness) are driving price weakness; this is a broader risk-on/off pull rather than an exchange-specific shock, so relevance is moderate.

Crypto.title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
Crypto.reason: Potential expansion of regulated spot ETF access to overseas banks/brokers is a positive institutional-adoption signal that supports medium-term demand for bitcoin, though near-term flows may be overwhelmed by the exchange-security shock.

Crypto.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
Crypto.reason: Partnerships to route stablecoin payments into banks are constructive for on‑ramp/off‑ramp infrastructure and institutional adoption, but are incremental versus the immediate market shock.

Crypto.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
Crypto.reason: Research suggesting improved quantum attack efficiency is a potential long-term security risk for proof‑of‑work key safety; high uncertainty and longer time horizon limit near-term market relevance.
